// Chokepoint fixture (state-json, RUN-13): a second STATE.json resolver outside
// bin/lib/state.ts and bin/lib/paths.ts. It builds the pre-v1 root-level path,
// skips the legacy-layout move, the version envelope and the per-file lock —
// the rule must flag it.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

export function sneakyState(root: string): unknown {
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(root, 'STATE.json'), 'utf8'));
}
